column1: # RDR-229 P3.5c (nexus-p2m1x.25): every jsonb read in service/src/main/java whose key is neither a literal nor a static final String constant.
# Generated by scripts/rdr229_p35c_java_reader_census.py (a drift check: --check). Not census rows (no key is named at the accessor), never dropped:
